company.name: JustPaid
company.shortDescription: JustPaid provides AI-powered accounts receivable software.
company.description:
The JustPaid platform comprehends, structures, and arranges contracts such as MSAs, POs, order forms, side letters, emails, modifications, and renewals to automate the whole receivables lifecycle, providing a centralized experience to automate and manage customer revenue.

The company is based in Silicon Valley, United States.

productsAndServices.description: A B2B finance platform that automates billing, invoicing, payment tracking, accounts receivable, collections, reconciliation, and revenue visibility across finance systems.
productsAndServices.name: JustPaid AI Revenue Operations Platform

productsAndServices.description: Automates invoice creation, scheduling, delivery, and tracking for recurring, usage-based, milestone, hybrid, and other complex B2B pricing models.
productsAndServices.name: Billing Automation

productsAndServices.description: Automates payment reminders, dunning sequences, escalation workflows, payment tracking, and invoice-to-payment follow-up to help finance teams manage receivables.
productsAndServices.name: Accounts Receivable and Collections Automation

productsAndServices.description: Uses AI to extract billing terms, payment schedules, obligations, renewals, and line items from contracts and convert them into billing and finance workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Contract & Billing AI

productsAndServices.description: Provides usage-event ingestion, real-time metering, aggregation, flexible pricing, and invoice generation for consumption-based and AI-oriented business models.
productsAndServices.name: Usage-Based Billing & Metering

productsAndServices.description: Matches payments from payment processors, bank accounts, and accounting systems to invoices and provides dashboards for collections, outstanding balances, and revenue trends.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Reconciliation and Revenue Insights

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,949,364 to $35,569,801, a 4.47x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
